reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.description: Review requests after visits and orders, private feedback, Google reviews with replies, and ratings per location.

apiError.already_reviewed: Feedback was already received for this request.
apiError.reply_in_inbox: Private feedback is answered from the inbox conversation.
apiError.awaiting_approval: This reply is waiting for HQ approval.
apiError.not_pending: This reply is not waiting for approval.
apiError.google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not set up on this platform yet. Add a sandbox connection meanwhile.
apiError.mandate_text_changed: The authorisation text changed. Read it again before accepting.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Ask customers for reviews after a visit, read private feedback and Google reviews, and reply.

chart.empty: No reviews in this period yet.
chart.ratingCaption: Bar chart of the average star rating per period, from 0 to 5.
chart.volumeCaption: Bar chart of the number of reviews per period.

reviews.sandboxReplyLong: Saved in BranchHarbor. This connection is in sandbox, so nothing was posted to Google.
reviews.emptyBody: Switch on review requests or connect Google Business Profile to see reviews here.

drawer.title: Review
drawer.privateHint: Private feedback goes to the location’s inbox. Reply to the customer from that conversation.
drawer.pendingBody: Submitted by {name}. It is posted once HQ approves it.
drawer.aiNote: Suggested by Marina. Check it before publishing.
drawer.replyHint: Everyone can read it on Google. No promises of refunds or personal details.
drawer.needsApproval: HQ approves replies to this review before they are posted.

send.title: Send a review request
send.hint: Requests are also sent automatically after completed visits when switched on. Opt-outs, consent, the frequency cap and quiet hours always apply.

outcome.sandboxed: Request recorded (sandbox: no message was delivered).
outcome.deferred: Scheduled for the end of quiet hours.

requests.emptyBody: Switch on review requests in Settings, or send one to a customer.

settings.scopeHint: HQ defaults apply everywhere; a location can override them.
settings.quietHint: Texts and WhatsApp wait until quiet hours end (local time).

consentHint.marketing: Only customers who agreed to marketing on this channel.
consentHint.service: A one-off follow-up about the visit, where local law allows it. Opt-outs are always respected.

settings.templateHint: Leave empty to use the default text in each language. Use '{name}', '{location}', '{business}' and '{link}'.
settings.subject: Email subject
settings.bodyHint: Must include '{link}'. Texts add the opt-out line automatically.
settings.noGating: Every customer sees these links after rating, whatever the rating. Showing them only to happy customers (review gating) breaks Google’s review policy.
settings.approvalHint: HQ marketing can always publish directly.

connections.connected: Google account connected. Link its locations below.
connections.title: Google Business Profile
connections.intro: Connect one Google account that manages many locations (HQ), or let a location connect its own. Reviews are fetched every 30 minutes.
connections.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not set up on this platform yet. A sandbox connection works meanwhile: it fetches no reviews and never invents any.
connections.sandboxNote: Sandbox: nothing is fetched from Google and replies stay in BranchHarbor.

royaltyDebit.noGroups: No franchise company to set up yet.
royaltyDebit.intro: HQ collects royalty, marketing fund and fee invoices from this account after each invoice is issued. A bank debit costs far less than a card.
royaltyDebit.pendingBody: Finish entering the account details. Bank debits activate once the bank confirms the mandate.
royaltyDebit.verifyingBody: Two small deposits will reach the account in 1–2 business days. Enter them on the verification page to activate the debit.

about.card: Charged on the due date. Higher card fees for HQ; works in any country.
about.us_bank_account: Debited from a US bank account through ACH. Settles in about 4 business days.
about.acss_debit: Business pre-authorized debit from a Canadian account. Settles in about 5 business days.
about.bacs_debit: Direct Debit from a UK bank account, protected by the Direct Debit Guarantee. Settles in about 3 business days.
about.sepa_debit: Direct Debit from a euro bank account (IBAN). Settles in about 5 business days; refunds can be claimed within 8 weeks.
about.au_becs_debit: Direct Debit from an Australian bank account (BSB). Settles in about 3 business days.

royaltyDebit.noBankDebit: Bank debit in {currency} is not available on HQ’s collection account, so only a card can be used.
royaltyDebit.mandateTitle: Authorisation you are about to accept
royaltyDebit.accept: I am authorised to sign for {group} and accept this authorisation. The exact text, my name, the time and my IP address are stored.
royaltyDebit.started: Authorisation recorded. Confirm the account to activate it.
royaltyDebit.settleNote: Bank debits show as processing for a few days. If one fails, you are told by email and HQ retries on the dates in its collection policy.

statements.issueHint: One statement per franchisee and currency. New statements are emailed to the franchise owners; issuing again refreshes the figures.
statements.emptyBody: HQ issues them after closing a period.

source.external_pos: Sales reported from an external POS

statements.feeNote: BranchHarbor’s flat collection fee for this period was {fee}. HQ pays it; it is never added to what you owe.
statements.emailed: Emailed to {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} on {at}.
statements.notEmailed: Not emailed (no franchise owner on file).
